comment: Looper for stock firmware. The footswitch (the effect's on/off) is the looper's button: press = record / play / overdub, double press = stop, double press when stopped = clear. The loop keeps playing whether the effect shows on or off. Mono loop (L+R), 12-bit block float, two buffers for undo. Long (experimental, MS-70CDR 2.10 only) adds 2.7 MB of RAM that MIDISTOMP's RAM test found unused. Screen: state, time and the loop's waveform with a playhead (zvis, MS-70CDR 2.10).

params.name: Fade
params.comment: How much of the loop stays on each overdub lap (100 = all, lower = older layers fade).

params.name: Undo
params.comment: Flip it either way to undo the last overdub; flip again to redo.

params.name: Long
params.comment: 1 = experimental long loops in extra RAM (MS-70CDR 2.10, not with MIDISTOMP). Takes effect when the looper is empty.
